summary: Gate 10 re-review of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability). B3 fix NOT applied — idb is still missing from package.json dependencies despite fix commit 9ddac16 existing in branch history. The PR diff against main shows no idb in the dependencies section. The fix commit was likely overwritten by a subsequent docs commit (3b46c125) that pushed a version of package.json without idb. All 5 prior findings (B1, B2, M1, M2, M3) remain resolved. Additionally, package.json has several out-of-scope changes vs main baseline (script changes, removed devDeps, version changes) that should be addressed.

B1.verification: useAutoSave.ts reads actual scene state from sceneStore via useSceneStore.getState()

B2.verification: package.json baseline mostly preserved — some out-of-scope changes remain (scripts, removed devDeps)

M1.verification: ResumePrompt.test.tsx and useAutoSave.test.ts import real production modules

M2.verification: console.warn added to persistenceService.ts catch block

M3.verification: console.warn added to all 4 catch blocks in persistenceStore.ts
